thresholds.persistence: first sampled threshold attainment with all later sampled values at/above threshold and at least 40,000 further interactions observed
thresholds.rationale: 75% is a shared engineering target below the already-known endpoint range. Checkpoint curves are inspected after specifying this criterion.

training.auxiliary_targets: published ten-model ensemble through 80000, then same fixed offline dynamic-programming targets
training.replay_change: published tree replay and importance weights vs matched uniform replay with replacement, unit weights and no priority updates

timing.primary: process CPU seconds, accumulated over training chunks; includes environment and in-memory logging
timing.secondary: wall seconds over training chunks; host concurrency documented for context

scope: Paired protocol in the archive main window. The same prior no-PER implementation retains the priority-tree insertion path and shared post-update residual calculation. Timing applies to these implementations. The 2025 historic Base DQN arm and its original environments are not being duplicated.
